answer.says: Ramesh, this is a good meal. The kadhi is light, which is what one wants in this heat. Sit, you have earned your rest as well.
answer.thought: The plan called for rest after lunch, but the body demands fuel first. I sit down to the kadhi and rice, the heat pressing against the windows behind me. It is a simple repast, yet it sustains the spirit that must yet confront the Directorate.
